meta.title: Optimize Font Loading Performance in Tests
meta.body_summary: Add font caching and deep clone to speed up font loading in generator integration tests; claims to reduce times from 10.7s to 4.2s and 21s to 18.3s.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added font caching and clone; maintainer closed within 17 min without review or comment; performance claim narrative only.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 89 changed lines across 3 test files, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step test performance optimization PR, but was closed immediately without review, inconsistent with the typical small-scope merge pattern.

review_details.concern_detail: PR received no formal reviews or human comments; closed by maintainer within minutes with no explanation.
review_details.performance_claim: Font caching and cloning reduces test times: fontSubset from 10.7s to 4.2s, full suite from ~21s to 18.3s.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer hand-dot closed PR ~17 minutes after creation with no comment; only bot interactions present.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Test-level performance optimization with caching was closed immediately without review, indicating a process boundary where unsolicited AI PRs are rejected quickly without engagement.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body lists before/after timings but no reproduction steps or artifacts; maintainer closure precluded any verification.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without any review cycle or fix iteration.

core_change_summary.description: Added font cache in test utility to avoid repeated file reads and used structuredClone/deep clone to prevent mutation of cached font objects. Test files updated to use the new cached loading.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: add font caching and update test files.
Second commit: prevent font cache mutation with structuredClone.
Third commit: further optimize font initialization to reduce memory pressure.
